# AstroFree

> AstroFree is a free AI-powered tarot reading and Vedic numerology platform. It offers instant AI-guided tarot readings across 8 spreads (including the 10-card Celtic Cross, 3-card spread, Career spread, and Yes/No oracle), Card of the Day meanings for all 78 cards, and free Mulank, Bhagyank, and Namank Vedic numerology calculators with support for 13 Indian languages and no signup required.

All core features are completely free with no paywall, credit card, or account requirement.

## Core Tools & Spreads

- [AstroFree Home](https://astrofree.vercel.app/): Overview of tarot readings, Card of the Day insights, and Vedic numerology tools.
- [Free Tarot Reading App](https://astrofree.vercel.app/reading): Draw cards interactively and receive AI-guided tarot interpretations.
- [Celtic Cross 10-Card Tarot Spread](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot/celtic-cross): Instant 10-card spread with position breakdown and upright/reversed analysis.
- [Three-Card Tarot Spread](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot/three-card): Past, Present, Future interactive 3-card reading.
- [One-Card Daily Tarot](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot/one-card): Single-card daily focus draw and reflection.
- [Love & Relationship Tarot](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot/love): Spreads and card meanings focused on romance, partnerships, and compatibility.
- [Career Tarot Reading](https://astrofree.vercel.app/career-tarot-reading): 3-card career & finances pull plus Life Path 1–9 career guide.
- [Yes or No Tarot Oracle](https://astrofree.vercel.app/yes-no-tarot): Instant Yes, No, or Maybe single-card oracle answer.
- [Mulank & Bhagyank Calculator](https://astrofree.vercel.app/numerology): Free Vedic numerology calculator by date of birth with 1–31 lookup tables.
- [Bhagyank Calculator](https://astrofree.vercel.app/bhagyank-calculator): Destiny number calculator by full date of birth.
- [Namank Calculator](https://astrofree.vercel.app/namank-calculator): Chaldean name numerology calculator.

## Tarot Topical Hubs & Guides

- [All 78 Tarot Cards & Card of the Day](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot): Upright, reversed, love, career, and Card of the Day meanings for all 78 cards.
- [Tarot Card Combinations Library](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot/combinations): Meanings and synthesis patterns for key two-card tarot pairings.
- [Major Arcana Meanings (All 22 Cards)](https://astrofree.vercel.app/major-arcana-tarot-cards-meanings): Complete Major Arcana table and The Fool's Journey stages.
- [Reversed Tarot Cards Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/what-do-reversed-tarot-cards-mean): How to interpret upside-down cards in spreads.
- [Tarot Study Guides Library](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide): Hub of beginner and advanced tarot and numerology tutorials.
- [Tarot for Beginners Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/tarot-for-beginners): Step-by-step introduction to reading tarot cards and framing questions.
- [Tarot Spreads Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/tarot-spreads): How to choose and structure spreads from 1 card to 10 cards.
- [Celtic Cross Spread Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/celtic-cross-guide): Deep dive into every position of the 10-card Celtic Cross layout.
- [Complete Tarot Card Meanings Reference](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/tarot-card-meanings): Quick-reference guide covering all 78 Rider-Waite-Smith cards.

## Vedic Numerology Topical Hubs & Guides

- [Mulank (Root Number) Hub](https://astrofree.vercel.app/numerology/mulank): Complete overview of Mulank 1–9, planetary rulers, and birth date chart.
- [Bhagyank (Destiny Number) Hub](https://astrofree.vercel.app/numerology/bhagyank): How full-date Bhagyank shapes life direction and career path.
- [Namank (Name Number) Hub](https://astrofree.vercel.app/numerology/namank): Chaldean letter values and name vibration analysis.
- [81 Mulank x Bhagyank Compatibility Matrix](https://astrofree.vercel.app/numerology/compatibility): All 81 Birth Number and Destiny Number pairings explained.
- [Mulank vs Bhagyank Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/mulank-vs-bhagyank): Difference between Birth Number and Destiny Number.
- [Vedic Numerology Study Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/numerology): Comprehensive guide to Ank Shastra, Life Path numbers, Master Numbers 11 & 22, and Chaldean name math.
- [Hindi Numerology Hub](https://astrofree.vercel.app/hi/numerology): Complete Hindi Mulank, Bhagyank, and Namank resources.

## Multilingual Coverage

All guides, card meanings, spreads, and calculators are available across 13 languages (`/hi`, `/hinglish`, `/bn`, `/te`, `/mr`, `/ta`, `/gu`, `/kn`, `/ml`, `/pa`, `/or`, `/as`) with `hreflang` annotations and localized sitemap URLs at `https://astrofree.vercel.app/sitemap.xml`.
